Description: Detected an old OpenSSH version (SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_6.6.1p1 Ubuntu-2ubuntu2.13) with publicly known vulnerabilities.
Recommended Mitigation: Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest stable version.

Description: Without CSP, the browser has no rules limiting scripts, making Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks easier.
Recommended Mitigation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header restricting trusted script and resource sources.

Description: The page can be embedded in an iframe on another site, enabling clickjacking attacks.
Browsers may MIME-sniff responses and execute files as a different type than intended.
The Server header reveals software details: 'Apache/2.4.7 (Ubuntu)'. Attackers can use this to find matching exploits.
Recommended Mitigation: Hide or genericize the Server header in the web server config.
